Member text jobs/pinakes-proquest-ingest/output/texts/EO_4798.txt withdraws 'the public lands in Ts. 4 S., Rs. 8, 9 and 10 E., G. & S. R. B. & M., Arizona' pending resurvey; those three townships are its only lands. The held revoking text jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-5262-revoking-withdrawal-land-for-resurvey-arizona.txt says 'Executive Order No. 4798 of January 23, 1928, which withdrew the public lands in T. 4 S., Rs. 8, 9, and 10 E. ... and Executive Order No. 4828 ... be and the same are hereby revoked as to the above-mentioned townships', signed January 20, 1930. The 'as to' qualifier only separates the two orders' townships: for EO 4798 it covers every township the order withdrew, so the whole withdrawal was revoked on issue (only the ex-service opening waits for the plat filing). The open B35 lead and its 'partial_revocation' edge misread this.
